rationale: The interpreter omitted a core requirement to use the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant attribute for retrieving and filtering Unit Type options, and it left three ambiguities from the ticket unresolved: mapping of Condenser Type, behavior when filters return no results, and case sensitivity/reset behavior. These gaps prevent a reliable implementation.

findings.description: The interpreter does not mention using the SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant attribute to retrieve and filter Unit Type options as required by the ticket.
findings.action: Add handling to retrieve Unit Type data from SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant and filter by the selected Condenser Type and Refrigerant.

sourceRefs.quote: the attribute to get Unit Type is SDCommonUnitTypeRefrigerant
Retrieve dropdown data from unitdesign GET /dropdowns.

findings.description: The ticket does not define how Condenser Type should be used to filter Unit Type options.
findings.action: Clarify the mapping logic for Condenser Type in relation to Unit Type filtering.

sourceRefs.quote: The Condenser Type mapping is unclear because the example parent data contains refrigerants.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify what should happen when a filter yields no results.
findings.action: Define the expected UI behavior when filtering returns an empty list.

findings.description: The ticket does not specify case sensitivity handling and whether downstream selections should be reset when a parent selection changes.
findings.action: Provide clarification on case sensitivity and selection reset rules.

sourceRefs.quote: Case sensitivity and downstream selection reset behavior are unspecified.
